description: This file contains PHP functions for generating XML-RPC method wrappers, class wrappers, and type conversions, primarily for facilitating remote procedure calls via XML-RPC protocol. It includes functions for creating PHP wrappers for user-defined functions, remote methods, and server classes, with introspection and code generation features.

methods.name: php_2_xmlrpc_type
methods.description: Converts a PHP type string to its corresponding XML-RPC type constant or string.

methods.name: xmlrpc_2_php_type
methods.description: Converts an XML-RPC type string to its corresponding PHP type string.

methods.name: wrap_php_function
methods.description: Creates a PHP wrapper function for a user-defined PHP function to expose it as an XML-RPC method, with introspection and code generation.

methods.name: wrap_xmlrpc_method
methods.description: Generates a PHP function that calls a remote XML-RPC method via a client, with options for signature, debugging, and code generation.

methods.name: wrap_xmlrpc_server
methods.description: Creates a PHP class that wraps all XML-RPC methods exposed by a remote server, generating code for each method.

methods.name: build_remote_method_wrapper_code
methods.description: Builds PHP code for a function that invokes a remote XML-RPC method, including parameter handling and response decoding.

methods.name: build_client_wrapper_code
methods.description: Generates PHP code to instantiate and initialize an XML-RPC client object with specified properties.
